[ISTS.8.1] **`spec_common.h` is the shared header.** It
contains:

- `#include "libds.h"` and standard C and POSIX
  headers ([ISTS.2.1]).
- `spec_fail()` helper.
- `EXPECT_OK` / `EXPECT_STATUS` macros.
- `spec_load_ds(engine, source)`: compiles DS source with
  the build's compiler and loads the artefact with
  `ds_engine_load_dsc` ([ISTS.2.3]). A source the compiler
  refuses returns `DS_ERR_PARSE`.

It must NOT contain:

- Any per-area helper (`build_engine`, fixture probes).
  These live in each test file. After ≥2 spec test
  files need the same helper, lift it — but not
  before, to avoid premature abstraction across
  diverging needs.
